    #Question 2

    #Part (a)

    When the rod rotates, points A, D, G displace by xA​, xD​ and xG​ respectively.
    Since the masses are connected to the rod via rigid links, the displacement of
    each mass is such that x1​=xA​, x2​=xD​ and x3​=xG​.

    Displacement at each point,

    xA​=3aθ=3θ

    xD​=aθ=θ

    xG​=aθ=θ

    xH​=3aθ=3θ

    Moment of inertia of each mass,

    Moment of inertia I=mr2.

    I1​=m1​(3a)2=9m1​

    I2​=m2​(a)2=m2​

    I3​=m3​(a)2=m3​

    Assume rotation in the anticlockwise direction.
    Springs k1​, k3​ and k4​ will be in tension.
    Spring k2​ will be in compression.

    Equation of motion,

    IE​θ¨=∑ME​

    (I1​+I2​+I3​)θ¨=∑ME​

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−k1​xA​rA​−k2​xD​rD​−k3​xG​rG​−k4​xH​rH​

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−k1​(3θ)(3a)−k2​(θ)(a)−k3​(θ)(a)−k4​(3θ)(3a)

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−9k1​θ−k2​θ−k3​θ−9k4​θ

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−(9k1​+k2​+k3​+9k4​)θ

    0=11mθ¨+(11k+9k4​)θ

    0=θ¨+11m11k+9k4​​θ

    where k=20000 N/m and m=5 kg

    Characteristic equation,

    0=s2+(2ζωn​)s+ωn​2

    0=s2+11m11k+9k4​​

    Natural frequency of system,

    ωn​=11m11k+9k4​​​=11(5)11(20000)+9(10000)​​

    ωn​=75.076 rad/s

    #Part (b)

    Equation of motion,

    IE​θ¨=∑ME​

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−(9k1​+k2​+k3​+9k4​)θ−cx˙B​rB​

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−(9k1​+k2​+k3​+9k4​)θ−c(2θ˙)(2a)

    (9m1​+m2​+m3​)θ¨=−(9k1​+k2​+k3​+9k4​)θ−4cθ˙

    0=11mθ¨+4cθ˙+(11k+9k4​)θ

    0=θ¨+11m4c​θ˙+11m11k+9k4​​θ

    Characteristic equation,

    0=s2+(2ζωn​)s+ωn​2

    0=s2+11m4c​s+11m11k+9k4​​

    ζ=11mωn​2c​

    Damped frequency,

    ωd​=75.0761−0.0242182​

    ωd​=75.054 rad/s

    Vibration response of system,

    θ(t)=Θe−ζωn​tsin(ωd​t+ϕ)

    where Θ=A2+B2​ and ϕ=tan−1BA​

    Evaluation of coefficient A,

    A=θ0​=0.5

    Evaluation of coefficient B,

    B=75.0540.1+0.024218(75.076)(0.5)​

    B=0.013445

    #Question 3

    #Part (a)

    • Node 14 → interior angle greater than 180°
      • Mapping of an area outside the element
    • Nodes 6 and 10 → incompatibility with adjacent elements
      • Incompatible connection results in displacement mismatch
    • Nodes 13 and 15 → degenerating element
      • Jacobian matrix will become zero if the nodes
        become closer and occupy the same point

    #Question 4

    #Part (a)

    Assume linear motion to the right.
    Assume rotation in the clockwise direction.
    Thus, k1​ will be in compression, k2​ will be in tension.

    Total displacement of each spring,

    d1​=x+r1​θ

    d2​=x−r2​θ

    Total displacement is the sum of linear displacement (due to linear motion),
    and rotational displacement (when the pulley rotates). If rotation is in the
    same direction as the linear motion, add the displacements.

    Equation of motion (linear motion),

    mx¨=∑Fx​

    M0​x¨=−F1​−F2​

    M0​x¨=−k1​(x+r1​θ)−k2​(x−r2​θ)

    0=M0​x¨+(k1​+k2​)x+(k1​r1​−k2​r2​)θ

    Equation of motion (rotational),

    Iθ¨=∑M

    J0​θ¨=M2​−M1​

    J0​θ¨=F2​r2​−F1​r1​

    J0​θ¨=k2​(x−r2​θ)r2​−k1​(x+r1​θ)r1​

    0=J0​θ¨+(k1​r1​−k2​r2​)x+(k1​r1​2+k2​r2​2)θ

    Expressing in matrix form,

    {00​}=[M0​0​0J0​​]{x¨θ¨​}+[k1​+k2​k1​r1​−k2​r2​​k1​r1​−k2​r2​k1​r1​2+k2​r2​2​]{xθ​}

    Assume free vibration responses to be,

    x=A1​sinωt   →   x¨=−ω2A1​sinωt

    θ=A2​sinωt   →   θ¨=−ω2A2​sinωt

    Substituting into the equations of motion,

    {00​}=−ω2[M0​0​0J0​​]{A1​A2​​}+[k1​+k2​k1​r1​−k2​r2​​k1​r1​−k2​r2​k1​r1​2+k2​r2​2​]{A1​A2​​}

    {00​}=[k1​+k2​−M0​ω2k1​r1​−k2​r2​​k1​r1​−k2​r2​k1​r1​2+k2​r2​2−J0​ω2​]{A1​A2​​}

    {00​}=[60000−20ω23000​30003900−ω2​]{A1​A2​​}

    Determinant of matrix (characteristic equation),

    0=(60000−20ω2)(3900−ω2)−30002

    0=20ω4−138000ω2+(225×106)

    ω1​2=2642.2

    ω2​2=4257.8

    #Question 2

    #Part (a)

    Equivalent stiffness of 2 springs in series,

    keq,series​=2k​=22×104​=10000 N/m

    Equivalent stiffness of 2 inclined springs,

    keq,inclined​=δy​Fy​​=δs​/cosαFs​cosα​

    keq,inclined​=keq,series​(cosα)2

    keq,inclined​=10000(cos30°)2

    keq,inclined​=7500 N/m

    Vertical stiffness of a spring.

    Stiffness of springs attached to rod QR,

    kQR​=4keq,series​+4keq,inclined​

    kQR​=4(10000)+4(7500)

    kQR​=70000 N/m

    Excluding the center springs attached to the mass, the other 8 springs in the
    enclosure will displace by the same distance when rod QR moves vertically.
    Thus, the 8 springs are connected in parallel.
